from projects.enwiki9.tools.seal_endpoint428_pair_layer0_10m import (
    calculate_economics,
)


def economics(candidate_archive_bytes: int) -> dict[str, object]:
    return calculate_economics(
        base_archive_bytes=1_635_695,
        candidate_archive_bytes=candidate_archive_bytes,
        base_forecast_score_bytes=109_557_404,
        incremental_program_bytes=1_747,
        calibration_factor=66.955334,
        required_gain_bytes=884,
        archive_ceiling_bytes=1_634_811,
    )


def test_exact_ceiling_passes_with_conservative_projection() -> None:
    result = economics(1_634_811)
    assert result["saved_bytes_10m"] == 884
    assert result["economics_pass"] is True
    assert result["conservative_provisional_score_bytes"] == 109_499_963
    assert result["provisional_target_margin_bytes"] == 37


def test_one_byte_above_ceiling_fails() -> None:
    result = economics(1_634_812)
    assert result["saved_bytes_10m"] == 883
    assert result["economics_pass"] is False
    assert result["archive_ceiling_margin_bytes"] == -1

"""Explicit public test-fixture preparation; inference itself never downloads model files."""
import argparse
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from protocol import POLICY, digest
from profiles import load_profile


def prepare(destination, profile_name='tiny'):
    profile = load_profile(profile_name)
    if profile_name == 'tiny':
        for dependency in ('torch', 'transformers'):
            if version(dependency) != POLICY['dependencies'][dependency]:
                raise ValueError('Pinned preparation dependencies required')
    destination = Path(destination)
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError('Use a new fixture directory')
    if profile_name != 'tiny':
        import hashlib
        import shutil
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
        specification = profile.specification()
        source = specification['source']
        downloaded = Path(snapshot_download(repo_id=source['repository'], revision=source['revision'], allow_patterns=list(source['files'])))
        for name, identity in source['files'].items():
            with (downloaded / name).open('rb') as handle:
                if hashlib.file_digest(handle, 'sha256').hexdigest() != identity:
                    raise ValueError('Prepared real-model artifact differs from its pinned identity')
        destination.mkdir()
        for name in source['files']:
            shutil.copyfile(downloaded / name, destination / name)
        return
    from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
    source = POLICY['source']
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(source['repository'], revision=source['revision'], trust_remote_code=False)
    model.save_pretrained(destination, safe_serialization=True)
    if (digest((destination / 'model.safetensors').read_bytes()) != source['safetensorsSha256']
            or digest((destination / 'config.json').read_bytes()) != source['configSha256']):
        raise ValueError('Prepared fixture differs from the pinned artifact')
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(source['repository'], revision=source['revision'], trust_remote_code=False)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(destination)
    (destination / 'revision.txt').write_text(source['revision'] + '\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--destination', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--profile', default='tiny', choices=['tiny', 'qwen05b-k-projection'])
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    prepare(arguments.destination, arguments.profile)
"""Explicit whole public input-embedding shard acquisition; no row-fetch service or private input."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
from local_token_rows import installed_inventory
from flash_weights import fetch_blob
from flash_source_scopes import TEXT


def provision(directory,local_storage_limit_bytes):
    spec=installed_inventory()
    if type(local_storage_limit_bytes) is not int or local_storage_limit_bytes<spec['wholeShardBytes']:raise ValueError('Explicit sufficient complete-file embedding budget required')
    directory=Path(directory);directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    missing=sum(v['bytes'] for name,v in spec['shards'].items() if not (directory/name).exists())
    if shutil.disk_usage(directory).free<missing:raise ValueError('Insufficient storage for complete embedding object')
    base='https://huggingface.co/'+TEXT['repository']+'/resolve/'+TEXT['revision']+'/'
    for name,value in spec['shards'].items():fetch_blob(base+name+'?download=true',directory/name,value)
    return spec


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--destination',required=True);parser.add_argument('--local-storage-limit-bytes',type=int,required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
    spec=provision(args.destination,args.local_storage_limit_bytes)
    print(json.dumps(dict(schema=spec['schema'],wholeShardBytes=spec['wholeShardBytes'],verified=True,fullModelExecuted=False,productionBackendAvailable=False)))
"""Provision only whole pinned public tokenizer/configuration files; no model weights or source installation."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
from flash_tokenizer import SOURCE
from flash_weights import fetch_blob


def provision(directory):
    directory=Path(directory);directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    missing=sum(value['bytes'] for name,value in SOURCE['files'].items() if not (directory/name).exists())
    if shutil.disk_usage(directory).free<missing:raise ValueError('Insufficient storage for complete public tokenizer artifacts')
    origin='https://huggingface.co/'+SOURCE['repository']+'/resolve/'+SOURCE['revision']+'/'
    for name,record in SOURCE['files'].items():fetch_blob(origin+name+'?download=true',directory/name,record)


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--destination',required=True);args=parser.parse_args();provision(args.destination)
    print(json.dumps(dict(schema=SOURCE['schema'],repository=SOURCE['repository'],revision=SOURCE['revision'],verified=True,modelWeightsAcquired=False,productionBackendAvailable=False)))
